title: Tell us what your business needs.
intro: Type it or just talk — the mic writes down what you say. The Factory's Business Intake agent checks what already exists in GMO's app development ecosystem, then tells you what can be reused, what must be extended and what must be created. Keep chatting to add details or answer its questions.
placeholder: e.g. I'm a lawyer starting my own firm. I need to register my clients and follow each client's legal process.
websiteLabel: Your website (optional) — the Factory reads it to understand your business
examples: I'm a lawyer: I need to register my clients and follow their legal process
I run a laundry and want to reward customers who come back
I sell purified water by route and need to track refills per client
note: Analysis only — nothing is created or changed in GMO.
